name: Netcad Yazilim Anonim Sirketi
summary: Netcad Yazilim Anonim Sirketi develops engineering and Geographic Information Systems software in Turkey. The company offers products and services, such as geographic information systems (GIS), mapping, urban planning, construction, agriculture and geology, and mining and forestry. It also provides Planet, a urban planning application; Netpro, manage transportation and water infrastructure; Netsurf, fast and flexible solution with 3D support for digital terrain models, topographic maps, and high-precision volume calculations; NetKamu, a expropriation project implementation solution; NetMap, a zoning and cadastre project application; NetHydro, an engineering solution; Yapinet-3D Cadastre Soft…
